document.title: Publish @vitadeck/host-companion with the SDK so scaffolded host plugins install
document.summary: The companion becomes a public npm package at the SDK's version, and the release workflow checks both versions against the tag and publishes the companion before the SDK.
document.why: The SDK scaffold for `create --host-plugin` and `--host-plugin-only` adds a devDependency on `@vitadeck/host-companion`, which is private, so [`npm install` in a scaffolded project fails with a 404](source:s1).

sources.label: PR #146
sources.title: build(release): publish @vitadeck/host-companion with the SDK so scaffolded host plugins install
sources.gist: Make the companion public, version it with the SDK, publish both from one tag.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 31
sources.gist: Máté asks to ship the companion to npm with the SDK, leaning toward lockstep versions, with no tag push or npm publish by the agent.

lookFor: Manual step: npm accepts a Trusted Publisher only for a package that exists, so Máté publishes the companion's first version by hand and then adds its Trusted Publisher, as [the PR says](source:s1).

groups.title: Publishable companion package
groups.why: The scaffold pins `^<companion version>`, so the companion has to be on npm at the version the SDK scaffolds; Máté [leaned toward lockstep](source:s2).
groups.summary: `package.json` drops `private` and moves to the SDK's 0.5.0, and the new `cli.test.ts` case fails when the two versions differ.
lookFor: `repository.url` is required: npm Trusted Publishing rejects a GitHub publish whose `repository.url` does not match the repo.

groups.title: Release workflow and runbook
groups.why: One tag has to cut both packages, and the runbook needs the one-time Trusted Publisher setup for the new package.
groups.summary: `release.yml` checks the tag against both manifests and publishes the companion before the SDK, and `docs/releasing.md` describes the same flow.
lookFor: Subtle: the publish steps are not idempotent. If the SDK publish fails after the companion published, re-running the job fails at the companion step because that version already exists.

groups.title: Docs stop calling the companion unpublished
groups.why: AGENTS.md, the companion README, ADR 0004 and two skills said the companion is not on npm, which this change makes untrue.
groups.summary: Each doc drops its "not on npm yet" note, ADR 0004 moves Publishing from Deferred into the lockstep decision, and the companion README switches to absolute links that work on npmjs.com.

commits.subject: build(release): publish @vitadeck/host-companion with the SDK
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The SDK scaffold for --host-plugin and --host-plugin-only adds a
devDependency on @vitadeck/host-companion, which was private, so a
scaffolded project failed npm install with a 404. The companion is now
public and versioned in lockstep with the SDK; one release tag checks
both versions and publishes the companion before the SDK.
